svg.text: LP-MSPM0G3507, seen from above, USB unplugged. Add the wires in the numbered order; each number sits at both ends of its wire and in the list below. The schematic shows the same circuit in symbols.
J1 and J2 are the outer columns, J3 and J4 the inner ones; pin 1, 21, 40 and 20 are at the USB end.
Wire colours: red 3.3 V, orange 5 V, black ground; every other colour is one signal.

g.text: Breadboard: holes a to e, and f to j, in one column are joined; each long rail is joined end to end.
Column 1 is at this end; rails and holes count up toward the top.
Wires, in the order you add them
Ground rail (blue, hole 2) to J3 pin 22 (GND)
Part 1: the motor and its driver
Place first: DRV8833 motor driver, 10 uF capacitor, DC motor
DRV8833 VM, breadboard j10 to J3 pin 21 (5V)
DRV8833 GND, breadboard j9 to Ground rail
DRV8833 STBY, breadboard j8 to 3V3 rail
DRV8833 AIN1, breadboard j7 to J4 pin 38 (PA28)
DRV8833 AIN2, breadboard j6 to J4 pin 37 (PA31)
DRV8833 AO1, breadboard j5 to Motor lead 1
DRV8833 AO2, breadboard j4 to Motor lead 2
KY-040 CLK to QEI connector pin 1 (PA29)
KY-040 DT to QEI connector pin 2 (PA30)
KY-040 SW to QEI connector pin 3 (PB14)
KY-040 GND to QEI connector pin 5 (GND)
DRV8833 motor driver: VM in g10, GND in g9, STBY in g8, AIN1 in g7, AIN2 in g6, AO1 in g5, AO2 in g4
10 uF capacitor: long leg (+) in h10, striped side (−) in h9
DC motor: beside the breadboard, pins toward the wires
KY-040 rotary knob: beside the breadboard, pins toward the wires
TM1637 4-digit display: beside the breadboard, pins toward the wires
The DRV8833 VM pin takes the motor supply (2.7 to 10.8 V); the logic pins are 3.3 V safe.
An electrolytic capacitor's stripe marks the − leg; the long leg is +. Backwards it can fail.
A DC motor is noisy and hungry: it gets its own supply through the driver; only the driver's logic pins meet the LaunchPad.
The TM1637 module's pins read CLK DIO VCC GND on most boards; check yours.
Then plug in USB, run the build, and expect
The motor follows the knob, the display shows the percentage, and the board does not reset when the motor starts.
The same circuit as a schematic

svg.text: Fox Red Labs. Pins from the build's pin table, the one the program is built from; the 3D build on the page shows the same wiring step by step. Board picture: TI SLAU873E, figure 1-1.
